title: Smoother first-message scrolling
summary: Sending your first text keeps the chat following latest, and messages stay above the entry field.

sections.heading: Chat scrolling
items: Layout changes after Send keep following the newest message instead of leaving you partway up the conversation.
Message rows stop at the mobile composer instead of showing through below it.
Shared scroll handling covers chat, DMs, reply threads and Pins comments while preserving your own reading gestures.
Restart to load this update in the Home Screen app or TestFlight.
